info.title: Gesture Particle Christmas Tree
info.bodyText:
✋ Gesture Instructions：
• Distance between thumb and index finger → Controls tree scaling & particle/confetti burst intensity
• Moving your hand left/right or up/down → The entire tree moves with your hand
(If camera permissions are not enabled, you will only see the automatically playing animation)
